title.value: Stochastic Neural Network with Kronecker Flow
title.justification: The title is explicitly stated at the beginning of the paper and throughout the document in headings.
title.quote: # Stochastic Neural Network with Kronecker Flow

analysis.description: This paper introduces the Kronecker Flow, a generalization of the Kronecker product to invertible mappings aimed at improving the scalability and expressivity of stochastic neural networks. The method is applied in variational Bayesian neural networks for predictive tasks, PAC-Bayes generalization bound estimation, and approximate Thompson sampling in contextual bandits, outperforming existing methods and baselines in various setups.

type.justification: The paper focuses on introducing a new theoretical framework, Kronecker Flow, and explores its properties and applications in stochastic neural networks.
type.quote: This limitation motivates a need for scalable parameterizations of the noise generation process... We propose the Kronecker Flow, an invertible transformation-based method...

name.justification: The paper is centered around extending Bayesian methods through the Kronecker Flow within stochastic neural networks.
name.quote: Another use case of stochastic neural networks is to understand generalization, via PAC-Bayes bounds.

name.justification: The paper applies Kronecker Flow to variational Bayesian neural networks, which is a subfield of Bayesian inference.
name.quote: We apply our method to variational Bayesian neural networks on predictive tasks...

name.justification: The paper mentions exploring reinforcement learning applications with stochastic neural networks.
name.quote: Stochastic neural networks (SNN) are a central tool in... exploration in reinforcement learning...

name.justification: The paper discusses the generalization properties and bounds related to PAC-Bayes learning.
name.quote: PAC-Bayesian learning theory specifically explores the generalization property of a randomized prediction rule, and has been recently studied in the context of stochastic neural networks.

name.justification: The paper introduces the Kronecker Flow, a type of normalizing flow, to improve expressivity and scalability.
name.quote: Minimization of Equation 1 and 3 requires (i) computing the gradient with respect to the parameter of the (PAC-)Bayesian posterior φ, and (ii) computing the entropy of q... hence referred to as the normalizing flow.
